name: SMTP on Port 26/TCP
description: Detects successful network traffic using TCP port 26. Port 26 may be used for mail or another service; observing this port does not identify malware or prove compromise.
note:
Investigation

1. Check the source, destination, time, firewall action, application, and whether the connection was allowed.
2. Confirm whether the source and destination are approved mail systems or another authorised service using TCP/26.
3. Check mail-server, authentication, endpoint, and threat records for the connection and any messages or processes involved.
4. Review repeated connections, unusual destinations, and related alerts.

Response

Do not automatically block or isolate the system from this alert alone. Confirm the service owner and business purpose. Escalate unexplained or unauthorised TCP/26 activity through the approved incident-response process.
author: Elastic
false_positives: Servers that process email traffic may cause false positives and should be excluded from this rule as this is expected behavior.
query: (event.dataset: (network_traffic.flow or zeek.smtp) or event.category:(network or network_traffic)) and network.transport:tcp and destination.port:26 and event.outcome:success
